# External Agent Migration Guidance

- Treat runtime swaps and standalone app replacements as coordinated migrations across registry, env vars, Compose, dashboard wiring, docs, and smoke tests; do not land one slice in isolation.
- Start from [openspace/config/standalone_apps.json](../../openspace/config/standalone_apps.json), [openspace/config/external_agents.contract.md](../../openspace/config/external_agents.contract.md), and [openspace/config/external_agents.json](../../openspace/config/external_agents.json); decide whether the replacement is a standalone app, an external agent, a linked MCP server, or a combination, then keep `id`, `kind` or `protocol`, URL env names, capabilities, and linked MCP servers coherent.
- For OpenHarness to AgentOS/AionUi migrations, verify whether the current surface is config-driven before deleting Python adapters. OpenHarness is currently exposed through `standalone_apps.json`, `.env*`, Compose, and dashboard consumers of `/api/v1/standalone-apps`; do not assume a dedicated gateway exists.
- For OpenClaw integration, check [openspace/host_skills/README.md](../../openspace/host_skills/README.md) before reusing Nanobot assumptions. OpenClaw MCP setup uses `openclaw mcp set` or mcporter and may need a different contract shape than `nanobot-mcp`.
- If the change also moves ports, update `.env*`, `frontend/.env*`, both Compose paths, and install docs together. Avoid collisions with AgentOS/AionUi `3308`, `OPENSPACE_RUNTIME_PORT` default `8788`, dashboard `7788`, and agents-monitor `5173`.
- If a runtime or app is removed from the dashboard surface, check [openspace/dashboard_server.py](../../openspace/dashboard_server.py), [openspace/standalone_apps.py](../../openspace/standalone_apps.py), [openspace/external_agents.py](../../openspace/external_agents.py), [openspace/external_agent_gateway.py](../../openspace/external_agent_gateway.py), [frontend/src/api/standaloneApps.ts](../../frontend/src/api/standaloneApps.ts), [frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx](../../frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx), and [frontend/src/pages/ShowcasePage.tsx](../../frontend/src/pages/ShowcasePage.tsx) before assuming the UI updates itself.
- Keep GHCR release surfaces aligned when Compose or env defaults change; review [docker-compose.release.yml](../../docker-compose.release.yml), [deploy/local-runtime/docker-compose.yml](../../deploy/local-runtime/docker-compose.yml), and [INSTALL_FORK_WINDOWS.md](../../INSTALL_FORK_WINDOWS.md) together.
- Prefer plan-first review when replacing a runtime entirely. Inventory stale env names, registry entries, dashboard cards, docs, and smoke coverage before deleting adapters or changing protocol labels.
- Separate legacy config cleanup from generated runtime data cleanup. Search `logs/recordings`, `logs/trajectories`, and other caches for the old app or agent id before deleting anything; generated artifacts need explicit confirmation when they are not trivially reproducible.
- Workflow bundling is not implied by standalone app registration. Before promising bundled workflows or tests for AgentOS/AionUi, verify whether workflows should be imported into OpenSpace recordings, exposed through showcase assets, or packaged as an external runtime bundle.
